name: Rae Lakes Loop
notes: The NPS describes Rae Lakes as a 42-mile loop. The current Recreation.gov export for this park contains quota-entry/corridor records rather than individual named tent sites, so these tokens are route points, not promises of a particular campsite; use the park wilderness permit map to choose actual durable sites.

name: High Sierra Trail
notes: Classic eastbound Sequoia traverse toward Kaweah Gap/Big Arroyo. The NPS route table gives 65.7 miles to the eastern endpoint; this park's current permit data is quota-entry based and does not enumerate every backcountry tent location.

name: Mineral King Loop
notes: Classic Mineral King high-country loop. Published trip reports place variants at roughly 30–45 miles and 10,000–13,700 feet of gain; this catalog keeps the permit corridor points available in the app, not invented campsite coordinates.

name: Big SEKI Loop
notes: Long Kings Canyon–Sequoia loop assembled from the Rae Lakes/JMT and High Sierra corridors. The route has several legal variants (Colby Pass versus High Sierra Trail); the park permit map is authoritative for actual camping locations.
